archive.summary: A short test-run window covering automatic pricing-update emails for special-rate firms, drag-and-drop restored in the Desktop app's Upload Window, and 8 bug fixes including a 2FA login crash and payment methods getting wiped mid-billing.

Firms got the ability to charge clients' saved payment methods directly, plus beta features for scheduling bulk client-chat messages and smoother CRM imports, alongside 23 bug fixes including a Stripe reconciliation issue and documents stuck in "Sending."
